'''Wisteria Town''' (Japanese: '''モダマタウン''' ''Modama Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Potpourri Island]] in [[Kanto]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Contest Hall]]. It was first mentioned in ''[[AG159|Off the Unbeaten Path]]'', when [[Nurse Joy]] told {{an|May}} that a [[Pokémon Contest]] was scheduled to take place there.

In the [[AG160|next episode]], Ash and {{ashfr}} arrived in Wisteria Town so that May could compete for her third [[Ribbon]]. She trained her {{TP|May|Munchlax}} for the battles as she wanted to use {{TP|May|Squirtle}} in the appeals. [[Harley]] arrived and revealed that he also had entered the Wisteria Contest and was planning on winning.

[[File:Harley Wisteria Ribbon.png|thumb|left|220px|Harley holding the Wisteria Ribbon]]
In the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], May was the first contestant to perform and sent out her Squirtle. It managed to perform very well, dazzling the [[Contest Judge]]s and audience members. After the other Pokémon got to perform, Harley entered the stage with {{p|Ariados}} and put on a scary appeal which shivered the audience. When [[Lilian Meridian|Lilian]] [[Contest announcer|announced]] the results, it was revealed that May and Harley had secured themselves a place among the eight {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s moving on to the [[Contest Battle]]s. They made their way to the final round, where they faced off for the coveted Wisteria Ribbon.

During their match, Harley used his {{p|Octillery}}. It went up against Munchlax and scored an early advantage by stopping Munchlax from using moves that would require charging up. Munchlax surprised them with {{m|Metronome}} which stalled Octillery long enough to suffer damage. Octillery {{m|rest}}ed up, however, and was fully healed. Harley and Octillery were victorious in the end after the latter woke up and finished Munchlax off with {{m|Octazooka}}. This victory gave Harley his fourth Kanto Ribbon.
